title: 4. Make real calls
script: Now we cross the network boundary. The generated Yahoo Finance tool reaches RapidAPI and returns current response evidence. We retain the status, timing, content type, byte count, body digest, and RapidAPI identity headers. We do not retain the response body in this recording receipt. The generated YH Finance tool reaches the same marketplace boundary and returns the account's current entitlement result. That is useful evidence too. A valid runtime credential, product entitlement, provider health, and semantic fitness are separate facts. The system must keep them separate if routing and fallback are going to be trustworthy.
